references.text: God establishes His covenant with Abraham and his descendants through all generations, an eternal covenant that includes future generations.
Moses makes the covenant with all Israel at Sinai, where the people gathered to hear the Lord's words and enter into a covenant relationship.
Moses emphasizes that the covenant at Horeb was not only with the fathers but also with everyone living today, pointing to the inclusive nature of the covenant.
The continuation of the text expands the covenant to include both those present and those not present on that day.
Isaiah speaks of an eternal covenant that God will make with His people, based on the promises given to David.
Jeremiah prophesies about a new covenant that God will make with the house of Israel, continuing the tradition of covenants.
The book of Hebrews quotes Jeremiah regarding the new covenant and shows how God's covenants span multiple generations.
